g.text: Weight-space fingerprints do not all predict retrieval
All 60 states; four learning-rate-index holdouts; one feature added to the locked baseline.
Dashed line: baseline RMSE 2.905. Blue: lower pooled RMSE and ≥3/4 improved folds.
Predictive flags are descriptive, not significance tests or causal/functional-utility evidence.
